appearance_facts.fact: Title text reads 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'.
A single blue line series connects six annual points across the full width of the chart.
The line begins at the highest plotted value on the left (2018) and ends at the lowest plotted value on the right (2023), with intermediate points between them.

printed_facts.fact: No numeric data labels are printed on the line; values must be read against the y-axis.

Required context selections: Facility record = 'Factory F', Review period = '2018-2023 production review', Routing program = 'Production trend response'.
uncertain: Exact production values for 2019–2023 are not labeled; readings are visual estimates from the y-axis.

The chart title states 'Increasing Production', but the plotted line's overall direction from 2018 to 2023 appears to decrease; the title and the line trend conflict and the intended interpretation is not stated.
